# Doc inventory

**As of 2026-10-11.** Generated by `npm run docs:inventory` (`scripts/doc-inventory.ts`); do not edit by hand. Judgments live in `docs/doc-inventory.judgments.json`; everything else is read from git and the files.

Re-run it, commit the result, and read the diff: that is the periodic review. A doc with no judgment, or changed since its judgment, is listed under *Needs review*. Hand-written docs older than 21 days show as aging, older than 45 as stale.
